facts.fact: A SiMODiSA and Allan & Gill Gray Philanthropy report, via Business Day, estimates fresh early-stage venture capital in South Africa at R3.3bn in 2024.

ZAF.note: Only the AU startup model law is mentioned, which is not a digital law text with a South African signature.

facts.fact: Business Day says South Africa does not currently have a dedicated, enacted Startup Act; one is proposed.

ZAF.note: Cape Town and Johannesburg are named as startup hubs only in passing, with no programme or cohort.
